hero.eyebrow: Pre-launch · open to students & teachers everywhere
hero.subtext: Padhai.pk brings students and teachers onto one safe platform. No more paying an advance to a "tutor" who never shows up.  Find a verified teacher for any subject, try a free demo, and start learning — with your payment protected until the session is actually done. If you can teach, list your skills and start earning from students who genuinely need you.

problem.heading:
Pakistan's tuition system runs on trust.
Right now, nothing protects it.
problem.body: Over 25 million Pakistani children are out of school — and the tuition system meant to fill that gap is almost entirely informal: Facebook groups, paper ads on walls, a stranger's WhatsApp number passed around. No verification. No safety net for your money. No accountability when it goes wrong.

cards.text: Appearing in his FSc Pre-Medical exams this year. His local academy charges Rs. 4,000/month — money his family can't spare. A "tutor" he found in a Facebook group took his father's advance payment and never came back.

Tops her class in Python and Web Development. She's already tutoring two juniors for free, purely because she's good at explaining things — but has no safe way to list herself, get paid properly, or prove her track record.
Ali needs exactly what Fatima can teach, and they're minutes apart. But nothing connects them safely — so Ali keeps struggling, and Fatima keeps teaching for free.

howItWorks.heading: Five simple steps. No scams, no guesswork.

steps.title: Post what you need
steps.text: Subject, level, budget, and the kind of teacher you're looking for. Takes less than a minute.

steps.title: Teachers send proposals
steps.text: Verified teachers respond with their price and a short pitch — you choose who feels right.

steps.title: Try a free demo, in-app
steps.text: An optional free demo session, right inside Padhai.pk, before anyone commits to anything.

steps.title: Pay into a safe escrow
steps.text: JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or card. Your money stays protected until the session is completed — no exceptions.

steps.title: Teacher gets paid, you both review
steps.text: Payment is released automatically once the session is confirmed. Both sides leave a review for the next person.

features.heading: Built for Pakistan, from day one.
features.subtext: Every feature below is already scoped and in development — this isn't just a pitch, it's the plan.

items.title: One platform, both sides
items.text: Students post what they need to learn. Teachers respond with proposals. You match on your own terms — not through a random Facebook post.

items.title: Posts & proposals
items.text: Subject, budget, and requirement every match. Teachers pitch with their price and a short introduction.

items.title: Get seen faster
items.text: Teachers can boost their profile to rank higher in search. Students can boost an urgent post to get proposals sooner.

items.title: More proposals when you need them
items.text: A simple monthly plan gives active teachers extra proposals once they've used up their free monthly quota.

items.title: Live sessions, right in the app
items.text: Demo classes and paid sessions happen over in-app video — no separate app, no sharing personal numbers with strangers.

items.title: Your money stays protected
items.text: A student's payment is held safely and only released to the teacher once a session is confirmed complete.

items.title: Get paid directly
items.text: Teachers link a bank account or mobile wallet straight to the platform — earnings come to you, with no middlemen.

items.title: JazzCash · EasyPaisa · Card · Bank Transfer
items.text: Pay however you already pay in real life. No foreign card, no complicated setup.

badgeProgram.heading:
2 free Verified Badge seats per subject.
Worth Rs. 1,999 — yours for free.
badgeProgram.body: We're earning trust before we chase traffic. The first two teachers to claim each subject get fully verified — CNIC check, qualification review, a short interview — completely free, plus a featured profile for 3 months. After these seats are gone, verification becomes a paid badge.
documentsRequired: CNIC — front and back (clear photo or scan)
Your highest qualification certificate or degree
Optional: a 2–5 minute sample teaching clip
policies: I confirm all information and documents I submit are accurate and belong to me.
I understand my documents will only be used by the Padhai.pk team, for verification purposes.
I understand sharing contact details with students outside the Padhai.pk platform goes against our Terms of Service.
I understand a free badge seat is limited to the first 2 approved teachers per subject, and isn't guaranteed until reviewed.
I agree the Verified Badge is valid for 1 year, and can be renewed afterward with a quick re-verification.
I agree to a short verification call with the Padhai.pk team.
I understand that if I don't log into the app within 3 days of launch, my free badge claim may be released to someone else.

faqs.a: A safe way for students and teachers to find each other. Students post what they want to learn, verified teachers send proposals, and paid sessions happen inside the app over video — with your money held safely until the session is actually done.

faqs.q: Is the Verified Badge really free?
faqs.a: Yes — completely free for the first two teachers per subject. That's a Rs. 1,999 value: CNIC verification, qualification review, and a short interview, at no cost, valid for one year. We make money later through optional profile boosts — not by charging you to get verified.

faqs.q: What happens after I join the waitlist?
faqs.a: You'll get an email the moment your subject is ready for launch, plus early access before we open sign-ups to everyone. If you applied for a teacher badge, we'll also email you the next steps for document review and your interview.

Padhai.pk is built for Pakistani students and teachers — priced in rupees, verified by CNIC — but our waitlist is open to anyone, anywhere, including Pakistanis abroad and teachers who want to reach students back home.

faqs.q: What if my subject's badge seats are already full?
faqs.a: You're automatically added to our general teacher waitlist, and we'll email you the moment a seat opens up or a new round starts. You're also welcome to apply again under a different subject.
